title: No electricity sundays ??
content: Last nights dream. I remember trying to get on the train (the station that the main road sort of morphs into, right outside the big doors for the theatre ) After one of the many late night party festival city nights trying to get home I guess or to my current hotel allocation. There was an East Asian female working and she told me and the crowd that the trains were down and no busses were running as it was a ‘no electricity Sunday’ . We were all confused and annoyed and she was clearly nervous to tell us. There were fireworks / sky symbols and events present last night too. These seem to coincide with the big party nights too. Streets full and lit up, full of people late at night.
